title: Subnet fabric upgrade and egress-health operator
creator: Aisha Mercado
description: Create a reusable Terraform module plus an accompanying controller/operator that performs safe upgrades and runtime health checks for VPC subnet fabric, NAT/IGW provisioning, endpoint routing, and route reconciliation. The goal is to reduce manual intervention during private deployment upgrades and to detect and remediate egress failures (NAT/IGW/route-table drift) before customer impact. The module should expose: subnet profiles (control/data/compute), explicit egress zones with active/passive NAT sets, endpoint service-backed route setups, automatic route-table canaries, and a health-check orchestration layer that runs synthetic egress checks and marks resources for automated reconciliation via our infra CI pipeline. This ticket covers design, Terraform module, operator shim, CI integration, and a canary rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Terraform module supports creation of 3 subnet tiers with tagging conventions and route-table templates; 2) NAT/IGW logical grouping with optional HA active/standby configuration; 3) Endpoint resources created with route-attachments for private service endpoints; 4) Operator runs periodic synthetic egress checks (ICMP/TCP to known endpoints) and writes metrics to our observability pipeline; 5) Drift detection triggers a Canary reconciliation job in staging and an automated PR for terraform changes when safe; 6) Integration tests in CI pass and staging canary shows <0.5% error rate during upgrade window.
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Deploy module to staging VPCs in us-west-2 with operator disabled (dry-run) and run static validation (terraform plan) across 3 stacks. Stage 2: Enable operator in staging, run synthetic checks against S3 gateway and internal telemetry endpoints. Stage 3: Canary upgrade of route-table template in 3 customer-like VPCs with automated rollback on failure. Stage 4: Gradual rollout to Dedicated clusters with feature flag and a 48-hour monitoring window.
test_plan: Unit: Terraform module unit tests (terratest) for resource creation and tagging. Integration: End-to-end deploy in staging VPCs, operator health checks, simulate NAT failure and observe automatic detection and reconciliation. Load: Run synthetic request burst to validate KV cache population for route changes. Observability: Verify metrics, alerts (PagerDuty rule), and dashboard panels in Grafana/CloudWatch.
